'''Collan Eislo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who desired to become a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], and led a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] called the [[Apex Society]].

==Biography==
Eislo was born into nobility and developed a fascination for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], believing that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was the ultimate power in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and that the Sith were the only people who were unafraid to wield the power that the Force granted. He therefore desired to become a Sith apprentice, so he studied [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]] and used his family's wealth to sponsor archaeological digs at Sith sites.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />

However, Eislo wasn't [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive to the Force]] and couldn't become a Sith apprentice, regardless of how many [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] he amassed. However, he heard legends that the [[Mask of Darth Nihilus|mask]] of the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] could grant the wearer the power to use the Force, so he desired to find it.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />

Along with the Apex Society, an organization of Sith devotees that Eislo led, he tried to track the mask and eventually traced the mask to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. Eislo and the Apex Society traveled to Volik, and Eislo promised the Society members that he would become their master when he possessed the power of the mask.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
